title: Betti cardinalities in a smooth projective curve family
statement:
Let $S$ be Noetherian
and let $f:X\to S$ be
smooth and
projective, with geometric
fibres of pure dimension one. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible on $S$.
Write $c_s$ for the number of connected components of the
smooth proper curve $X_{\bar s}$, and
$g_s=\sum_D g(D)$ for the sum of the
genera over its connected components.
Then the etale cohomology
cardinalities are

$$
|H^r(X_{\bar s},\mathbf F_\ell)|=
\begin{cases}
\ell^{c_s},&r=0,2,\\
\ell^{2g_s},&r=1,\\
1,&r>2,
\end{cases}
$$

and each of these functions of $s$ is constructible.

proof.text: For each geometric fibre C=X×_S Spec(kappa(s)^alg), smooth relative dimension one and properness follow by base change and projectivity. Nonvanishing of the coefficient integer in the residue field persists in its algebraic closure. Apply lem-fin-smooth-proper-curve-natural-cardinalities to get the four natural-cardinality formulas, with arithmetic genus in degree one.

Reuse the existing public theorem proper_smooth_geometric_components_locally_constant for f. Its proof already contains finrankH_unit_eq_card_components, the scalar-compatible identification of zeroth coherent dimension with component count. Thus the geometric component count c is locally constant; compactness of the Noetherian base gives finite range, and its clopen level sets are compact open, hence constructible. No duplicate dimension theorem is introduced. Apply lem-fin-geometric-coherent-source-ranks in degree one to the structure module: it is quasicoherent and finitely presented, and flat over S because f is smooth and the module is invertible. The source pullbackObjUnitIso and finrankH_congr identify this geometric fibre dimension with arithmetic genus g. Consequently g also has finite range and constructible level sets. The coherent-rank route for genus is retained, while the existing component-count theorem supplies c.

Define b(r,s) by the three displayed cases, initially with arithmetic genus. Split r=0, r=1, r=2 and r>2 to prove Nat.card(Sheaf.H)=b. Since the prime powers are nonzero, Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero proves actual finiteness. Transport Cardinal.mk across the existing natural Ext/derived comparison and use Nat.cast_card to obtain the first conjunct, with the original derived-cohomology expression.

The fibre structure morphism is smooth proper of relative dimension one. Apply genus_eq_arithmeticGenus to replace arithmetic genus with the differential-form genus used in the unchanged statement. The comparison applies without connectedness.

For a finite-range function a with constructible level sets and F:Nat→Nat, the range of F composed with a lies in the finite image of range(a). Its n-level is the union of a^{-1}(m) over the finitely many m in range(a) satisfying F(m)=n. Finite unions are constructible. The fully proved private helper constructible_comp_nat supplies this argument. Apply it to the component count with F(m)=ell^m and arithmetic genus with F(m)=ell^(2m); all remaining degrees use the constant one function.

lean.statement: theorem projective_curve_betti_cardinalities {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsProjective f] (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (hinv : ∀ s : S, (ℓ : S.residueField s) ≠ 0) : ∃ b : ℕ → S → ℕ, (∀ (r : ℕ) (s : S), Cardinal.mk ((Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s)) (r : ℤ)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s)).constantZMod ℓ))) = b r s) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (s : S), b r s = if r = 0 ∨ r = 2 then ℓ ^ Nat.card (ConnectedComponents ↥(pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s))) else if r = 1 then ℓ ^ (2 * (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField s) (AlgebraicClosure (S.residueField s)))) ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField s)).genus) else 1) ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, (Set.range (b r)).Finite ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, Topology.IsConstructible {s : S | b r s = n}
